title: Booking Deposit Terms for Entry & Patio Door Contracts
content:
Every Entry & Patio Door Contract takes a booking deposit before the final measure.

## Required deposit

- **Cash, check or card contracts.** The required deposit is the larger of the series deposit percentage of the signed contract price and the series deposit minimum, but never more than the signed contract price.
- **Ridgeline financing contracts.** For a contract whose payment method is Ridgeline financing, the required deposit is the series financed deposit percentage of the signed contract price with no minimum, and is zero where that percentage is zero.
- Amounts are rounded to the cent.

| Payment method | Percentage amount compared with the minimum | Required deposit |
|---|---|---|
| Cash, check or card | Percentage amount above the minimum | The percentage amount, capped at the signed contract price |
| Cash, check or card | Percentage amount below the minimum | The minimum, capped at the signed contract price |
| Ridgeline financing | No minimum applies | The financed percentage of the signed contract price; zero where that percentage is zero |

## Timing

The deposit is due within the series deposit window, counted in calendar days from the day after the contract signing date. A deposit that has not arrived by the end of the deposit window does not cancel the contract by itself; the measure simply stays unbooked.

The final door measure visit is booked only after the required deposit has been received in full. Whether it has been received in full is read from the payments recorded on that contract against its signed contract price and payment method.

The final measure is offered within the series measure booking window counted in business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) from the day after the deposit is complete.

## Recording and card limit

Money received before order release up to the required deposit is recorded as a booking deposit and anything beyond it as a progress payment. A single card payment may not exceed the card limit.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contracts)

- **Cash contract.** A Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door contract signed at $7000.00, paid by check, with the Portal 640 deposit percentage of 40% and minimum of $900.00: 40% of $7000.00 is $2800.00, which is larger than $900.00 and not more than $7000.00, so the required deposit is $2800.00.
- **Financed contract.** A Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door contract signed at $9000.00 on Ridgeline financing, with the Glide 840 financed percentage of 15%: the required deposit is $1350.00, with no minimum.
- **Financed at zero.** A Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door contract on Ridgeline financing, whose financed percentage is 0%: the required deposit is zero.
- **Deposit window.** For a contract signed on the 10th of a month with a 5-day deposit window, the window counts the 11th as day 1 and runs through the 15th.
- **Measure window.** A deposit completed on a Friday, for a series with a 10-business-day measure booking window and no federal holiday in the span: the following Monday is business day 1 and the Friday of the next week is business day 10.
- **After the deposit.** A payment received before order release once the required deposit has already been received in full is recorded as a progress payment.
